swerc_1993_duplicate.question: swerc-1993 is not a separate contest: it is the 1993 Western European Regional in Swansea (werc-1993)
evidence: ETH call for participation, SWERC 1994 (comp.org.acm 1994-08-10, https://groups.google.com/g/comp.org.acm/c/1Gt2N7tXcwo/m/rlG3TDDBBwsJ): 'Last year, Europe was split into West and East'; Swansea hosted the West European Regional Contest, the East European Regional was held in Bulgaria; for 1994 West Europe was divided into a Southwestern (ETH Zurich) and a Northwestern region (Amsterdam, same dates)

ETH problem set archive page B_EU_SWERC/1993 (our copy swerc/swerc-1993/problemset/19980202-wayback-acc39d56/index.html) is titled 'Western and Southwestern European Regional Contest 1993' and holds Chess, Compress, Cube, Logic, Rename, Spin, Vertex = the seven problems of werc-1993 (nwerc93.pdf: 'Western European Regional at University College Swansea / Problem A Chess')

ETH 'Swansea 1993 Echo' (our copy swerc/swerc-1993/website/2026-09-07-wayback-24db6bf4/files/90ab46099f40b49c.html): the two ETH teams that won the Zurich local contest went to the 'Westeuropäische Regionalausscheidung 1993 in Swansea'
swerc_1993_duplicate.swerc_1994_note: swerc-1994 (season 1995, outside this area) is a real contest (ETH Zurich, 11-12 Nov 1994, contest day Saturday 12 Nov) that shared its set with werc-1994 (Amsterdam, same dates): problemsets swerc-1994 and werc-1994 list the same eight problems but are two set files
